facts.claim: Bolette (Fred. Olsen Cruise Lines): Entered service 2000; 62,810 GT; 1350 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 238 m length; ex-Amsterdam class.
Bolette is a feminine given name.

Notable people with the name include:Bolette Gjør (1835–1909), Norwegian writer and missionary
Bolette Roed, Danish musician
Bolette Sutermeister Petri (1920–2018), Danish-Swiss travel writer
